reviews.title: Bad food bad service even in biz class
reviews.text: Worst food they pull Out of freezer absolutely pathetic service and food and staff was very very dry
reviews.author: alex h

reviews.title: Fuerteventura Trip Outbound
reviews.text: Check in and bag drop was no problem and we sailed through security. Lounge was a bit of an issue as it is not easy to find at LGW and is quite a walk. Additionally, they did not open until bang on 05:00 and there was quite a queue to get in. Once in the food and beverage were good and the seating area comfortable. Boarding was smooth and the A320 was clean and relatively new. The flight was comfortable, faultless and arrived 30 minutes early.
reviews.author: handyspanner

reviews.title: Shocker from Heathrow to Sydney,
reviews.text: Shocker of an experience, late departure, seat very uncomfortable, unable to sleep or rest properly on the leg to Singapore, 787 totally unsuitable for a flight of this length, unable to stretch due to metal box under seat in front, food and service ok. Late departure from Singapore however arrived on time, brutal flight.
reviews.author: Jim M

reviews.title: Fabulous
reviews.text: Outstanding flight exceptional staff so happy and helpful . Also as usual such a good flight we was slightly late going but they made up time . Service on board was lovely food was so good especially on the returning flight for some reason it was nicer then our flight from London . Overall BA has never been disappointing we up graded to club Europe was well worth it .
reviews.author: Kim man

reviews.title: Very disappointing experience! Highly not recommend these airlines!
reviews.text: In late August I traveled from Athens to New York having a connection flight in London- both flights were with British airways. My first flight from Athens to London got very much delayed and as a result I missed the connection flight to NY. We were informed that we had to spend the night to London and travel the next day to our final destination. Most passengers got a voucher for accommodation, transportations and meals (both dinner and breakfast for the next day). To my astonishment, I received none. When I asked the reason they told me that the airlines did not have other vouchers for the rest of us and it was my responsibility to find somewhere to stay, get a transport and of course have something to eat for the night and the next day before the final flight. I was traveling by myself, I had no cash on me and, of course, my phone sim card did not work in Great Britain. So, I as ked help from other passengers and I made some calls. I found out that the nearest hotels to the airport were overbooked for the night except one that cost around $470 / night (US dollars). It was an outrageously expensive price but I had no other option. Of course to the expenses was added transportation by taxi (I was carrying 2 big luggage, a laptop and a backpack). No voucher for food or refreshments was given to me so I needed to save money for all the extra costs and the second luggage that I paid again the next day taking the other flight. No matter how much I tried to receive some help British Airways employees were completely unhelpful and seemed like they had absolutely no clue on what to do. I faced a big discrimination in terms of who they chose to give the voucher and who did not deserve it. Next day I tried to speak to a British Airways representative in the airport but there was absolutely no one. It was a big waste of money, a painful trip both physically and psychologically. I am never traveling with British Airways again.
reviews.author: Julie

reviews.title: B.A Cityflyer
reviews.text: Just returned to Edinburgh from Palma on the 10 Sept on BA4514 and would like to thank Christopher the cabin manager for a truly first class service, both my wife and I are quite nervous flyers but his fantastic sense of humour and friendliness throughout the flight put us at ease and he could not have been more helpful. What an asset he is to B.A. Cityflyer and we hope that he gets the recognition that he deserves. Highly recommended airline, comfortable seating, lots of legroom and fantastic staff
reviews.author: Les M

reviews.title: Dreadful and illegal service
reviews.text: We bought tickets 15 weeks in advance and they tried to downgrade one of us to economy despite the fact they were selling business class seats on the flight an hour before departure The staff were rude arrogant and unhelpful. On the return journey, the flight to London Heathrow was cancelled. They then proceeded to try and send us halfway round Europe win by law. They should’ve put us on another flight of another airline that was leaving for Heathrow. They also co-chair with Iberia and the Iberian staff in Madrid were absolutely disgraceful. .
reviews.author: Martin G

reviews.title: Mrs
reviews.text: The flight was really good but the car hire AVIS took $97 from our account when we arrived home with no explanation, our receipt was zero, NOT happy about that
reviews.author: Jennifer F

reviews.title: British Airways: non functioning website, helpline staffed with unhelpful people, telephone contact impossible.
reviews.text: By joining Ryanair and Easyjet, BA has now sunk to its lowest depths. The website is erratic - it does not allow one to check in within the 24 hour period allowed. The telephone staff rather than helping, erased my personal profile information when I checked later. Trying to type it in again, the webform would not allow me too. Calling the helpline again, a message tells me no calls can be taken as they are too busy. Absolutely terrible
reviews.author: louisthedog

reviews.title: BA 639 ATH to LHR
reviews.text: Checkin, security, lounge and boarding at ATH was faultless. We were 40 minutes late departing due to congested traffic control, however, we were only a few minutes late arriving atLHR. Flight was on a new(ish) A320 which was comfortable for the three hr plus flight and I was lucky enough to have two spare seats next to me. Cabin staff were ok, but nothing to write home about. Generally, a positive experience.
reviews.author: handyspanner

reviews.title: Pathetic, Shameful British Airways
reviews.text: We have travelled long haul twice this year, paid for World Traveller Plus (premium economy) at an extortionate price, and the service has been woeful. Many toilets out of commiossion on one flight, food choices not available on all flights, the stock of drinks inadequate on all flights to provide the paid for "complimentary bar service", running out of many popular drinks half way through the flights. The airline's customer service team have openly acknowledged in their responses to my complaint, “we understand why you needed to complain”, “we know this isn’t what you expect when you travel with us”, “we know this experience didn’t meet our usual standards”. But when requesting recompense, merely offered e-vouchers for future flights which are of absolute no use, as our travel plans are mapped out for the next 12 months. One of the e-vouchers had also actually expired.........When requesting monetary recompense (our form of actual payment), BA point blank refused, they also denied that we had paid for World Traveller Plus, so why were we seated there and allowed in advance to pay a further premium to select our seats? I have e-mailed a complaint direct to the CEO - nil response, and to their customer affairs office - nil response. BA do not care about their customers, and it sadly feels like post Covid, they have a monopoly if customers want to travel to the Caribbean, so can get away with providing a shoddy service. If you can, use another service provider.
reviews.author: blokka

reviews.title: Poor Customer Service
reviews.text: checked in for our flight to New York two tickets purchased together in January for a July flight, we have been given separate seats but can sit together if we pay, feel like I am being robbed at gunpoint! I refuse to pay for a seat when I have payed for my flight but not to put us together is awful customer service.
reviews.author: KevinLondon

reviews.title: Budget experience at premium price
reviews.text: We chose British Airways as a supposedly better airline than the budget options due to the length of the journey. We booked well in advance but after a month or more our feeder flight at a great midday time was cancelled and we were moved onto a very early morning flight with a long wait at Heathrow (this seems to be the pattern). Our outbound flights were at least fairly pleasant once in the aircraft. The aircrew were attentive and we got food and wine. Coming home was a different experience altogether. The aircrew seemed uninterested (barely even communicating with each other) and the entertainment system did not work (no sound). We were crammed in like sardines. Then there was a 10 hour wait at Heathrow for our final flight which was very full and the crew seemed stressed and sharp with customers. I've given two stars rather than one because they did get us there and back safely but come on British Airways, you can't charge premium prices and provide cattle-truck transport.
reviews.author: Chris T

reviews.title: Terrible Flight
reviews.text: I was ready to give this a 2-star review just because of the flight experience, but after what happened after the flight I've had to bump the review down to 1 star and if I could give zero stars, I would. First of all, we spent an hour and 30 minutes without the plane even taxiing because the pilot didn't know he needed a "wingman". Then many other planes took off before us even though they came after us. In total, we were delayed by about 2 hours and 30 minutes, when we were supposed to land at 16:30 and landed at 18:45. They didn't even have the decency to compensate us for the delay, which most airlines do. Now, I was going to give this a 2-star review, but then this happened: They lost BOTH of our bags. Yes, our bags were stuck in London while we were in Austria. They still haven’t shipped them, and when we tracked them, it said they’re missing. It was a 3 hour flight and they lost our bags. Even though they took an hour and a half on the runway loading bags and waiting for the wingman, they didn’t load ours. Wen we came to report lost baggage, we saw 4 other passengers waiting to report their baggage. Never flying on British airways again.
reviews.author: Om S

reviews.title: DO NOT FLY BA, Cancelled flights 3x
reviews.text: Will never fly BA again. We booked flights before CoVid and cruise got cancelled. BA REFUSED to give us a refund, instead giving us credits. Had to use within 2 years. Booked new flights in 2022, 9 months before trip to Germany 6/2023. BA cancelled flights 2 times, 3 months before trip. Had to reschedule for day before costing us more in hotels. 2 weeks before flight from Phx to London, cancelled connecting flight to Frankfurt. Had to scramble to get new connecting flight. BA found us seats but not in Premium economy. Did not even offer us first class. HORRIBLE customer service. Returning flight from Frankfurt to London connecting to Phoenix, CANCELLED 9 hours before we left. AGAIN had to scramble to get flight out. BA booked us on Lufthansa but would not give us seats. Tried to put us in economy instead of premium economy, which we paid for. 12 hour flight turned into 20 hour flight. Not sure what happened to BA but WILL NEVER FLY BA again!!! In flight service was terrible. Crew never picked up trays for over 2 hours.
reviews.author: Paula V

reviews.title: Slow. Expensive.
reviews.text: Flying from Paris to London. Each ticket was nearly $400 (a 1 hour flight). We were in a 25 person check in line for easily over 50 minutes. Many airlines provide kiosks for self check-in. Not this one. Trying to figure out why this airline is so expensive. If you fly business class (or whatever they call the first handful of rows) they simple put a tray table over the middle seat?? What exactly is the extra money going towards… the waters and sour cream pretzels? The hydroplaning at takeoff was cool too….
reviews.author: John P

reviews.title: Never Keep Their Schedule
reviews.text: We have never flown BA before. The flights themselves were good. Premium Economy seats were very nice - comfortable and love the extra amenities. The problem is on the way over to Venice we left Seattle late and our plane to Venice left early (without us). We might have been able to make it if they didn't leave early. Then there were no flights until 8 hours later. It was MISERABLE. To top it off, they canceled our flights on the way back home and rebooked us on American Airlines less than 24 hours before. They sent an email telling us they canceled our flight and rebooked, but they did not say how to check in. We could not check in on BA site and the numbers in the email were not usable on the AA site. We called AA for help (wait and call time about 40 min) and they said we had to talk with BA. We called BA and they said we had to talk with AA (wait time and call totalled about 90 min). I would not let BA hang up. We finally found out there was another number we needed in order to check on AA site. WHY DIDN"T BA SEND THAT NUMBER??? They rebooked flight was a downgrade from premium economy to general cabin. We did not want to fly with no leg room 18 hours. We had to pay more money for a bit more leg room (~$400) even though our cabin was down-graded. There were no seats for my husband and I to sit together so for 18 hours we were separate. I have an auto-immune disease and can't eat gluten. On the flight over I got a GF meal, but it really was not a meal at all. It was like a kindergartner's snack bag. Very strange. I had another GF meal reserved for the way home, but when they rebooked they did not transfer my meal. I tried to get them to give me a meal, but they said they couldn't because it was less than 24 hours before flight. Unfortunately we were in a part of the airport were we bused over so there was only one option for food and all of the options included bread except a fruit cup. I bought that - it was beautiful, but was in-editable / hard. So I went 10.5 hours without food - it was awful and I had the shakes pretty bad when we landed. Then the 2nd leg of the flight on AA they only gave us 1 round of water for a 6 hour flight. That was miserable. BA does not reimburse you automatically for price differences or anything else. The estimated compensation in my opinion doesn't even come close to what it should be. If I can avoid it we will probably never fly this airline again. Both to and from Italy were overall very bad experiences. It's not a good sign. 2 for 2.
reviews.author: Marie S

reviews.title: Three trips in a row my flights were cancelled !!
reviews.text: 48 hours before my flight was scheduled to leave, I got an email from BA saying that they were "very sorry" but my flight was cancelled. "Good news", they were able to book me on an alternate flight leaving that same day! "Bad news", this alternate flight was NOT a direct flight...they were NOT able to still seat me in Business Class...I was going to arrive in London 7 hours after my original flight...and NO there was no compensation that they were going to give me. They told me to inquire with American Airlines (I booked through them to use some airmiles I had) after I returned from my trip. I contacted American who "chuckled" and said that since it was British Airways that cancelled the flight, they are the ones who owe me compensation. This started a one month campaign to get someone at BA to talk to me and refund the difference in dollars and in miles between an economy ticket and a business class ticket. I also reminded them that since I arrived at my destination more than 4 hours after my original ticket, by law they owe me compensation. I was rerouted to different departments over and over...I have spent several hours on the phone trying to resolve this. Today when I tried to call AGAIN, I only get the message that they have a high call volume and so they are not taking more calls today and to try again later. What??? Well I can bet that you have a lot of calls!! Every flight you cancel has repercussions for all of those travelers and you have to deal with that! If this was my first rodeo, I might chalk it up to bad luck...but out of my last 4 flights on British Airways, 3 of them have been cancelled !!! One of them was cancelled AFTER I WAS ALREADY ON BOARD!! Never have I received any compensation other than a rebooked flight the next day (or the day after that). I don't know what their problem is...aging fleet with mechanical issues? Staff shortages? Whatever it is, they are doing nothing to mitigate the damages they are doing to their customers. This last flight (June 2023) was the very last flight I will EVER take on British Airways. I book my flights months in advance and then as time for my vacation gets closer, I begin to book activities at my destination. British has cost me many an attraction ticket fee (since the delay meant I wasn't there to attend) as well as hotel stays when a flight is cancelled (which they have not compensated me for at all). This is no way to run an airline and I'll be moving over to their competitors on my very next trip. British (for me) is too big of a risk to book with again. Do better British Airways!!!
reviews.author: Phyllis E

reviews.title: Took all my money
reviews.text: Last year I booked a flight to San Francisco for me and my wife, to fly this August. I April, 4 months before the flight I had to cancel the flight. Of the £1700 fare, British Airways will only refund us with £295. I would never book with them again, as they took almost all of our money. I never expected this from British Airways, who I always held in high regard.
reviews.author: Peter

reviews.title: Shocking Airline with it's customer service
reviews.text: Re : case reference 24951792 So surprised with the top UK airline which behave like a client cheating company! I have booked a return air ticket through BA.com. When I make the reservation, they pop up an option of "price lock" at GBP9.9 meant the price will be locked for 72 hours before I complete the purchase. I purchased this option. I then try to complete my purchase within 72 hours but the system cannot get thru my transaction. I tried to reach out to online CX and they ask me to call their hotline. I called their hotline and they can't fix the issue. I have been keep looping between online CX and hotline for few hours and since the 72 hours are due, I decided to make a new purchase online and it went successfully. Then I reach out customer service to request for 2 refunds. 1. price lock refund which is not working at all and 2. the price delta I paid for the price lock vs the new transaction that I've paid for the air ticket. After repeating email, they keep on marking around me by saying the refund cannot be made after 24 hours or something... I have repeatedly explained to them that issue is their system not allowing my transaction completion online and this is like setting up a way to cheat customer for GBP9.9 which is not able to complete the tx online. I've clearly requested the escalation but repeatedly getting ignore... I am so surprised for this experience and pls try not to use BA as small thing like this they will ignore you, dont expect they will take care of you during your trip at all. I am very disappinted for this happening in a large airline company like BA!
reviews.author: Frankie W

reviews.title: Business Class BOS-LHR -- A mixed bag
reviews.text: This was on a Boeing 787. We used the Lounge at Boston Logan for our dinner, as the flight was scheduled to leave very late (9:40pm). The food there was good. First off, why is BA the only airline that CHARGES for seat assignments in business class? The new business class seats were a mixed bag: The good news is that every seat has access to the aisle (and, therefore the toilets). The bad news is that the configuration doesn't have much space. The seat is a little constrained and the bed padding is a bit firm. There is hardly any cubby space -- just two tiny spaces that will hold a phone and that's it. There's no place for shoes, for example, unlike every other lie-flat seat I've tried. The service was good enough. As usual, the "Priority" tag on our checked bags had no meaning -- our bags came out mixed in with everyone else's.
reviews.author: Isambard40

reviews.title: Good BA flight
reviews.text: Gibraltar airport is lovely and quiet with an outdoor first floor viewing terrace airside. Boarding was by group and is quick as the plane is parked next to the gate. Pre-reserved seats ( a bit over-priced). The smallest bottle of water and a small bag of pretzels were provided free. No IFE -not even a moving map. Plane nice and clean, good announcements, on-time departure and early arrival-though LHR were not ready so we had a few minutes wait to disembark.
reviews.author: Jeremy C

reviews.title: Carmel
reviews.text: In relation to the recent trip with British airways , had extreme discomfort in different means - our elderly parents flew and had enough trust on the British Airways but to the sideline , they had a horrendous journey all along , in the first place the first flight from Chennai to Heathrow delayed by 3 hrs and along the way we also opted for wheel chair assistance, but there were made to walk all along not valuing their age and medical ailment , when they reached Heathrow , we were not in a position to reach out to them and in that time we reached out to the British airways customer care and they were sluggish and treated us to stooped low by yelling at us despite not understanding the overall situation, they were really low on the way they treated their customer , finally they landed in Boston and had finally hiccups where in their baggage was delayed and received it after 48 hours and many time sensitive food were there , just brining it to the concerned officials , everyone value their time immensely and no Carrier flies anyone for free and please do have the diligence to treat their customer with fairness and gratitude . Overall not a pleasant journey of flying with British airways - 3/10 rating
reviews.author: carmel allwyn F

reviews.title: Extra special treatment of a passenger
reviews.text: My 84-year-old Dad was flying from Sacramento, CA to Barcelona with a layover in Heathrow. When he got off the plane he got dizzy and fell. Within seconds he had multiple BA staff and Heathrow staff attending to him. He was disorientated and in need of medical attention. The attending team was calm, efficient and did not leave his side. They got him into a wheelchair and into an ambulance to the nearest hospital. Shout out to Colin at the Heathrow airport staff who was spectacular as was Danny (medic on a bike) and one other gentleman, all of this group made my Dad feel safe, and cared for while the BA staff rebooked flights for my daughter and mom who were traveling with my Dad as he needed to be seen by a Dr. they also arranged for a hotel for all 3. Huge appreciation and thank you to all involved. This whole team was dreamy.
reviews.author: Chris D

reviews.title: Late arrival
reviews.text: Coach class from LHR to KRK this afternoon Plane was an hour late leaving, and was 35 minutes after expected arrival time. Staff as always were friendly and efficient on board. Lounge access and fast track security came with our status and made the experience so much more pleasant
reviews.author: tim r

reviews.title: Another good Business Class flight.
reviews.text: We had a pleasant afternoon flight from London to Tel Aviv. While boarding was somehow chaotic, the flight crew were lovely, the suites - comfortable, and the food (including the VLML) - tasty.
reviews.author: TheShis

reviews.title: A good trans-Atlantic Business Class flight
reviews.text: We had a good redeye flight with BA's Business Class from Los Angeles to London. The food was very nice and the service was pleasant, too. Boarding, however, was hectic and disorganized.
reviews.author: TheShis

reviews.title: National Carrier - maybe of a third world country.
reviews.text: We flew premium economy from LHR to SFO for our 25th wedding anniversary. Arriving at San Francisco we found our luggage was damaged preventing it from being pulled along. I should add that my arm was immobilised and in a sling for the duration. Unable to find a BA representative at SFO airport we continued with our holiday. Returning to LHR 3 weeks later (with my arm still immobile) we were again unable to find a BA representative to report the damage to. Two days later I made an online claim but received no human response for 2 months which was - "This should have been reported within 7 days of the incident". I challenge somebody from BA to respond to this - Am I expected to spend my whole holiday attempting to contact customer services to lodge a claim with very limited internet access.
reviews.author: Steve M

reviews.title: another sorry performance by BA
reviews.text: Last Tuesday, they cancelled the last flight CDG-LHR. The airport hotels were full, as so were most hotels in Paris, because of the Paris Air Show. Many passengers were stranded in the airport and spent a sleepless night. No-one from BA was there to help, only staff from the ground handling agent. I secured a motel room north of CDG at an extortionate price. Came back next day, flight delayed by two hours. I could go on, but I'll just give you my advice. If you must fly, Easyjet is no worse than BA, and cheaper. If possible, take Eurostar.
reviews.author: Chris Pocock

reviews.title: HORRIBLE EXPERIENCE!!!!
reviews.text: British Airways is the WORST airline i’ve ever flown and I will NEVER fly with them again. After a 6 hour delay and waiting around in the airport for them to announce, they cancelled our flight at 2:30 am and told everyone to fend for themselves in finding a hotel in London, causing extreme distress and chaos amongst all 600 passengers. We had to spend $1000 on a last minute hotel at 2 am (of which they are barely compensating). THEN we get on the plane the next day and have to wait 2 HOURS AND 15 MINUTES before take off??? How unprofessional!!!! Not only that but they have costed us thousands of dollars of our family vacation that have gone to waste. I expect a refund from British Airlines as this is atrocious and nothing i’ve ever seen before. You guys should be totally ashamed!
reviews.author: Claudio D

reviews.title: very good
reviews.text: take off and landing was very good crew was very helpfull and good good food was good as well.......
reviews.author: hotels and airlines reviews

reviews.title: PDX to LHR and back
reviews.text: Looking to take advantage of this new direct flight and Alaska codeshare we booked on BA. The Portland gate crew were disorganized and confused. Boarding was a crazy free for all with no clear announcements other than to ‘stand behind the blue line’. Once boarded we settled into our business class seats. The cubbyholes were tight but nice enough with plenty of small storage areas, large retractable table, warm blanked and relatively comfortable seats. I did not use their video however my wife said the viewing options were limited. Our flight was delayed by over an hour (which seems to be a daily occurrence as we can see PDX and the BA gate from our house) so we were quite hungry by the time we took off. Once airborne the galley ovens were not working properly so it was almost two hours before we were given just the appetizer. By the time dinner was ready it was late and I was tired so I skipped my main to get some sleep. The morning snack was unmemorable. On our return flight the gate crew at LHR were surprisingly disorganized which seems ridiculous seeing as LHR has been home to BA for years. And once again we’re we’re delayed over an hour before taking off. I did find the food on our return trip to be quite tasty with good options- the only good highlight of our flights. My wife and I found the flight attendants to be attentive but very disinterested. All in all this was my worst international flight experience and I will certainly look at other alternatives before I consider flying BA again.
reviews.author: Kevin M

reviews.title: Poor choice
reviews.text: Once again no choice of seats in Club as they have been blocked out by staff - surely full fare passengers should have first choice
reviews.author: Stuart H

reviews.title: BA once great now appalling
reviews.text: What a shame that what was once a great airline now offers such abysmal service. I recently contacted the BA Executive Club to have some airmiles belonging to my deceased wife transferred to my account. The customer services person I spoke to having just heard my wife was dead said " I cannot transfer those airmiles without speaking to the account holder please let me speak to your wife" I found this most distressing and had to respond " No you cannot because she is dead". There was no apology, no remorse just a comment that the matter would need to be referred internally as he could not speak to the account holder . In addition I paid for a World Traveller Plus ticket back from South Africa on June 4th 2023 and the entertainment did not work on an eleven hour flight. I tried to get some compensation and there was no interest at all from British Airways so called customer service just a series of pre written standard paragraphs saying sorry in about ten different ways, but sorry is not compensation. BA now make Ryanair seem like a very top end airline. In my view there is no customer service, if I were a shareholder I would be commissioning a thorough review of the current management team and so called customer services team. I used to be an advocate singing the praises of BA. How can I possibly do that or refrain from factually recounting the appalling service I have been receiving? You only have to look at the number of poor reviews here to see the customer perception of what once was good but no longer is.
reviews.author: Stephen G

reviews.title: Disrespectful unacceptable treatment of customers
reviews.text: Never, ever again will I fly with BA. After successfully checking in online, my brother was denied boarding without receiving any reasonable explanation. He spent three hours with the BA representatives at the airport, trying to understand why he was not allowed to board. We made multiple unsuccessful attempts to obtain a refund. In the end, BA reluctantly admitted that there was no record of his presence and issued a mere 10% of the original fare. The manner in which they handled the case was utterly unacceptable. BA shamelessly ripped us off.
reviews.author: OAlt

reviews.title: Scared. Alone. Vulnerable.
reviews.text: Cancelled our flight while we were air side. They automatically rebooked us on a flight… positive! I think not. The flight they rebooked us on (may I mention it was only a few hours later) was from london city airport. Heathrow is west of London. City sits firmly in the east. See the problem? Thing only got better. The flight arrival destination was assumed to be Amsterdam where we had planned on going. It was not. In fact, the lovely people at BA saw a flight to Rotterdam and thought that’s close enough. Obviously, we had a few issues with this so we were to go to customer service. We got moved from 3 different customer service locations only to be told to move again. We had enough so we just stay put (4 hours later). We eventually made it to the front. Our friends not on air side (trying to check baggage) we’re told there were no flights to Amsterdam over the next two days from Heathrow. What a surprise to find a 6am flight the next day on the website! We obviously changed the delightful Rotterdam flight to this more accurate option. Back to us at the air side, we obviously had the dilemma of where to stay. Of course, we assumed maybe BA would help. When we spoke to the customer service person, they told us it wasn’t possible for us to stay at the airport and that we could spend the night joyfully on a bench outside. For reference, we are young females fresh out of adolescence so this idea seemed rather obscene. After a minor breakdown, they finally said we could stay at a hotel and actually she took pity on us and provided us with lots of help. I would give her a 10/10 rating but I would say that’s potentially the only positive of our day. This was not over yet however. We had to get out of the airport. We spoke to around 5 different members of staff, none of whom knew how to leave the airport if already air side. What a joy it was to try exit the lovely atmosphere of panic and chaos that pervaded every crevice! anyway, we eventually managed to leave after about an hour of bargaining, headed through immigration and eventually arrived at the hotel. BA, please get a grip as I am pretty sure 2/3 of the people inside that airport had their flights cancelled.
reviews.author: shjdjvifkrjddjdosksdhdjsjss

reviews.title: Business Class Flight from LHR to BOS
reviews.text: This was in an Airbus 380. BA appears to be the only airline to charge for seat assignments in business class. So even though we booked 6 weeks before the flight, we ended up on a full flight in one of the worse seats in business class. The seats on this A380 are very old and tired. Although they are roomy and comfy, and do have a nice cubby for shoes, the design does not give access to the aisle from some seats without possibly stepping over a neighbor's legs. If two people wish to be side-by-side, then you fly backwards. There is a USB port that DOESN'T CHARGE. The entertainment system crashes repeatedly. Check-in was slow because of the huge volume of passengers, even in business class. Terminal 5 is a disaster -- avoid it. There are two lounges at opposite ends of the terminal, but since they don't announce the gate until shortly before the flight, you have no idea which one is closest. Each lounge is HUGE and crowded. Some of the gates take 15 minutes to get to. Some stands actually use buses !!! When we got on the airplane it was BROILING hot because the ground support vehicle was broken -- we sweltered for over half an hour because we were delayed in departure. The food was pretty good and the service as one should expect. Once, again, the "Priority" page on our checked bags had no effect whatsoever -- half of the economy class bags came out before our's did. WE will avoid BA after this experience. Aer Lingus is MUCH better.
reviews.author: Isambard40

reviews.title: Never Ever use British Airways again
reviews.text: Absolute disgrace. This plane must have been manufactured in the 50s not only was the furnishings falling apart the seating was just pathetic. I have never been on a plane so cramped. I am 6ft 2" but slim and I had to force my self into this gap, my knees were wedges against the seat in front. This plane should not even be flying it was so old. How this compnay get away with this is a joke. I fly to puerto rico 7/8 times a year. Never again will I ever use British Airways.

reviews.text: This BA flight from Rhodes to Gatwick was on an aircraft operated by Avion Express, a Lithuanian charter company. It was the most awful flight we have ever experienced. It was 2 hours late. There was so little legroom that my knees were hard up against the seat in front. reviews.title: Never again
reviews.text: Worst economy flight, the seats were not comfortable at all I booked American airlines as their flights were great but now british airways have taken over never again. Staff were polite and helpful but the overall experience and comfort was not the one for me. Sticking to Virgin all the way!!
reviews.author: Lisha J

reviews.title: Horrible flight and airport experience
reviews.text: If there was a way, i would give them a negative five star review. My parents flew from India to US and their baggage were damaged. We ignored the loss and we understand that it things like this happens. My parents are diabetic and vegetarian. I had requested vegetarian meal for both them yet during the long flight of approx , crew stated that ran out of vegetarian food and did not have enough snacks or something else to substitute. My parent landed at Heathrow hungry and exhausted. We had requested wheelchair assistance but the serive provider did not show up on time and waiting at the transit where they were supposed to be dropped to catch next flight. My parents missed their connecting flight. The staff at the airport are absolutely unprofessional and heartless. After multiple requests, they were provided only 18 pounds for snacks. My diabetic parents were without food for almost 14-15 hours (unaccetable). they waited at the connection for the next flight for almost 10 hours and almost missed the other one too as the staff did not come on time to pick them up. After hue and cry staff realised that my parents were about to miss the flight again. They made it safely back home. It was ordeal and thats the nightmare of any child for their parents when they travel. I WOULD NEVER RECOMMEND THIS AIRLINES

reviews.title: Mr
reviews.text: 2 hours + late on the way to Vienna because 1st officer didn’t show up. No priority boarding for baby, ended up close to last on board so had to trek down to the end of the plane to find overhead space for luggage. Way back, check in only has one staff member to service all check in. Flight showing delayed 20 mins already. Only reason it’s not 1* is because the plane is slightly more comfortable than Ryanair/easyJet.
reviews.author: Drew

reviews.title: OMG or how the say in Scotland Jung Crivvens help ma boab
reviews.text: For 12 years I have been flying with BA from GLA to FRA Business trips and also to Malta on Holidays. I am so sorry that I have booked the flight to Malta already. But I can say this was it with Sliver executive card and any flights with them. I wonder why they are called BRITISH Airways. Nothing British in them. You get emails at 2359 hours that tell you that your flight is cancelled. and as one has to get up at 0400 to get ready and catch the first ferry from the island I live it doesn't really come to mind to check your email. Both flights cancelled which I found out when I was on the ferry and checked my mail then. I was rebooked. OK with Lufthansa., who must have made a new record to loose luggage on a direct flight from GLA to FRA. Anyhow after 2 days I got my stuff. Now, clever as I am, I check my email, straight away the day I was flying back and got another email. My flights are cancelled. Ok rebooked via City but then that flight was also delayed. I asked kindly in Frankurt with BA which flight I could be getting as this one is delayed and I can't get that flight. Oh we can't help you. You need to check in London. Hmm really helpful!. So I get to London City and talk to customer services there at the desk and now the best. Flying business, paying the extra money, being an executive member of BA and they guys says. "I don't care" that is the best since sliced bread. This is incredible. I don't care. I loved that part. Here you pay over the top and get as a response I don't care. My flight was delayed in City again which meant I wont be able to make it back home and have to fork out extra money again which really wasn't my fault. But as he said he doesn't care. Dear BA I have had 5 complaints open last year, booking business but flying economy, opening a complaint and getting as an answer we try to do better the next time and I asked straight away for a refund between economy and business. Other complaints never answered. Not an answer at all. Flights being cancelled more than 12 hours. getting back to London no connecting flights, needing taxis, the list is endless sorry to say. Your customer service is gone, helpfulness and I couldn't have praised you more when I started flying with you. As you don't seem to care and I found an airline that can do it some 45% cheaper than you and also business. Let's give give them a try and i saw they where even cheaper from GLA to MLA via Frankfurt business than yourself and this by a big margin. See I don't care either anymore. you taught me so well to don't give a sh*t. Cheerio and all the best Spanish oops sorry British Airways

reviews.text: Long flight as you can imagine took nearly 24 hours to get home. Was my first time flying with BA and I was excited flight going wasn't so bad, snacks weren't great l've had better, coming home was a joke delay after delay, planes leaving other places late, having to wait for crew to board and clean the plane. London to Manchester some of the crew were rude and miserable definitely in the wrong job and need customer service training, I got up to use the toilet asked kindly one member if I could get past, she looked me up and down like I'd inconvenienced her, then getting off the plane she never said a word ooked at everyone with a snarl, then to top it off my boyfriends case didn't come off the other end at Manchester him and 12 others, communication has been a disgrace like no one is bothered he hasn't again things no had been communication stolen out at all of it emails which iS being a nad a case for 4 days, he finally received it today and found disgrace blanked, will absolutely never fly with BA, my case is damaged I've complained but I've been ignored what's the point in having a complaints system if you don't respond, pay the extra money and fly with some decent|
reviews.author: Lizzi E

reviews.title: Nearly perfect
reviews.text: I have mobility issues and a friend recommended mobility assistance and not to be embarrassed as he team are used to it. I am so pleased I took his advice. Arriving at terminal 5 it was easy to find the special services at the far end of check in. The team were very professional, helpful and pleasant. I was wheeled to the plane then had an equally good experience at Rhodes where I was wheeled to the taxi que. In Rhodes one has o alight on a lift which was novel. The return service was also excellent. I have to say without exception ALL the staff were just amazing with special assistance as were the cabin crew. I am off to San Francisco with BA Club in September so I will book again. I highly recommend this service. One small point is that I feel it would be far nicer to be held in the Club lounge rather than the corridor or tiny room for two hours. I did not see a lounge either side and had to wait by the gate for the flight out for 3 hours.
reviews.author: Peter W

reviews.title: Delayed again
reviews.text: BA changed our flight times after booking, thus eating into our holiday. 2nd time this has happened. Flight is now delayed by over 2 hours - lost track of how many times my BA flight has been delayed. Flights from all other airlines are on time according to the departure boards. So just BA then. AGAIN. Their app is atrocious, communication is appalling and I won't be using them in future.

reviews.title: Mixed Experience
reviews.text: Check in at LGW very quick and easy The outbound flight service was poor, unintersted two person scruffy crew who were really only interested in serving a couple in Row 1, constantly fussing over them.... It was an 06.50 flight so just breakfast served The inbound flight was a completely different experince with a great crew of two who handed out menu cards and spent the entire flight topping up drinks and snacks after the main lunchtime meal
